stem: Several plants show chlorosis while root-zone EC has risen, irrigation distribution is uneven and roots in affected containers are poorly aerated. What is the best diagnostic approach?
choices: Assign a single nutrient deficiency from leaf color alone
Integrate spatial pattern, root-zone measurements, irrigation history, tissue data and root condition before changing nutrition
Ignore roots because symptoms are visible in leaves
rationale: Visual symptoms can have nutrient, irrigation, salinity, root and disease look-alikes. Differential diagnosis should combine multiple evidence streams before intervention.
